subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Izabela Dabrowska is a Mexican-American chef and cookbook author.
• Mexican-American cuisine blends traditional Mexican flavors with American ingredients.
• Dabrowska's recipes celebrate this fusion and have been featured in over 50 publications.
• Her 2019 cookbook Sabores was published by Culinary Press.
• Her 2021 cookbook Cocina Nueva was published by Heritage Books.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize the order in which two of Izabela Dabrowska's cookbooks were published. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Izabela Dabrowska's recipes, some of which appeared in 2019 and 2021 cookbooks, celebrate Mexican-American fusion cuisine.
choices.B: Izabela Dabrowska's 2019 cookbook Sabores was followed two years later by her cookbook Cocina Nueva.
choices.C: Mexican-American chef Izabela Dabrowska has featured her work in over 50 publications, including Sabores and Cocina Nueva.
choices.D: Izabela Dabrowska's 2021 cookbook Cocina Nueva was published by Heritage Books; another was published by Culinary Press.

explanation: Choice B is the best answer. The sentence emphasizes the order in which two of Izabela Dabrowska's cookbooks were published, indicating that Sabores was released in 2019 and Cocina Nueva was released two years later (2021).
